## Summary

Describe the goal and the changes. Link the related issue(s).

## Verification

List checks actually performed and their results. For documentation, review the diagram, endpoint schemas, responses and consistency with dependent services.

## Contract impact

Name affected services and owners. State whether request/response/event schemas, data ownership or game rules change. If none, say so.

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes match the agreed service boundaries and Lab 0 scope.
- [ ] Affected service owners have been asked to review shared contracts.
- [ ] Documentation and relevant private README copies are synchronized, or a linked follow-up explains what remains.
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, credentials or dependency directories are committed.
- [ ] Submodule changes point to pushed commits accessible to the professor(s), if applicable.
